card.name: Punctuation right before carbamazepine/Tegretol or CYP isoforms
card.fires_on: Punctuation (a comma, slash or opening parenthesis) that comes right after a drug or enzyme name and before a brand name or the next item in a list. Typical cases are carbamazepine with Tegretol, and CYP3A4 with 5.

modes.label: Comma or bracket near carbamazepine
modes.description: Comma or opening parenthesis between carbamazepine and its brand name Tegretol, or in an inducer list.

modes.label: Slash in CYP3A4/5
modes.description: The slash joining CYP3A4 to 5 in enzyme names.

card.plain: It fires on the punctuation that links a drug name to its brand name or a partner enzyme, mostly around carbamazepine and CYP3A4.
